task_definition.task_description: Please hold the best available recommendation for 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 in electronics for my account, then use that recommended choice to build the cart item and place the order with the best discount using my credit card. After that, generate an invoice for that item with coupon code SAVE15 and send it to user@example.com via Stripe, create and email me an order and invoice summary, then check technology news, schedule a medium-priority “Post-Purchase Follow-up” reminder for user@example.com on 2026-01-16 from 10:00 to 10:30 using “technology” as the description, and finally remove the original black XM5 item from my cart.

user_input.query: For my account user_123, please hold the best available recommendation for 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 in electronics, then use that recommended choice to create the cart item and place the order with the best discount using my credit_card. Use coupon code SAVE15, and note the original product_id is p_sony_xm5_blk. After that, generate an invoice for that item and send it to user@example.com via stripe, then email me an order and invoice summary as well. Also, check technology news, and schedule a medium-priority reminder called “Post-Purchase Follow-up” for user@example.com on 2026-01-16 from 10:00 to 10:30 with technology as the description. Please include the participants user@example.com and tags shopping and invoice, and finally remove the original black XM5 item from my cart.
